Senior Year.title: The Client Project
Senior Year.description: This was our last project of Senior Year, we had to pick a client and create a website for them. I chose to do a website about the Marlboro High School Newspaper. In the website I used HTML and CSS.

Senior Year.title: The MRHS Website Design Challenge
Senior Year.description: Worked on this project with Hayley and Cooper. We basically made an easier way for students in this school to find clubs. In this project we all had to work on separate branches and commit back to a main branch. We used JSON, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, and etc.

Senior Year.title: Winter Holiday and Traditions Website
Senior Year.description: This was a project that we did leading up to winter break. We had to create an interactive website based off of a holiday, season, tradition, or celebration of our choice. I chose to do a holiday advent calendar. In this project I used HTML, CSS, Bootstrap, JSON, Vue, and the concept of having cards flip up at reveal text on the back of it.

Junior Year.title: Haloween Animations
Junior Year.description: A Halloween-themed website featuring creative CSS animations and interactive elements.

Junior Year.title: Wildcard Website
Junior Year.description: This project was a wildcard website, meaning we could make whatever kind of website we wanted. I chose to do a website about the actor Gene Kelly. In this website I used HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, my own research, and my wireframe I created.

Junior Year.title: Mad Lib Website
Junior Year.description: In this project we had to create a website that was a Mab Lib, using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

Sophomore Year.title: First 10 Elements
Sophomore Year.description: In this project we practiced using transformations and transitions to make an animated study guide for the first 10 elements on the periodic table. Unfortunately I could not find this project on Replit. In this project we used transitions, transformations, HTML, and CSS.

Sophomore Year.title: Designer Tribute
Sophomore Year.description: In this project we had to choose a famous designer and create a website about them. I choose to do Nikola Tesla. Unfortunately I could not find this project. In this project we used HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap.

Sophomore Year.title: Solar System
Sophomore Year.description: This was our first project project in the Web Design Program. We had to design and create a website that teaches kids (around age 6) about the planets in our solar system and we had to provide a link to NASA. Unfortunately I could not find this project on Replit. We used HTML and CSS for this project.
